lead_raw_text:
The structure of NdZn3 is tetragonal with space group P4/nmm (No. 129) and a unit cell containing 8 atoms, Nd2Zn6, distributed over 4 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives Nd centers 12 Zn neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Zn environments vary between 11 and 12 neighbors, including Zn–Nd contacts. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 8 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing between 11-vertex and 12-vertex Zn polyhedra.
